references.text: Continuation of the description of the lampstand, with details about the branches, bowls, knobs, and flowers
Bezalel carries out the work and makes the lampstand of pure gold according to the instructions given here
Describes the craftsmanship of the lampstand as hammered work of gold, from its base to the flowers
Solomon made lampstands of pure gold for the temple, five on the right side and five on the left
The ten golden lampstands in Solomon's temple, made according to the specification
Zechariah's vision of a golden lampstand with a bowl of oil on top and seven lamps
The letter to the Hebrews mentions the lampstand as part of the holy place in the tabernacle
John sees seven golden lampstands in his vision, symbolizing the seven churches
Explanation of the seven golden lampstands as representing the seven churches
Christ walks among the seven golden lampstands
This is the direct historical fulfillment of the instruction given in the source verse.
Specifies and confirms the specific construction method (hammered work) mentioned in the source verse.
Shared construction technique ('hammered work') to create holy objects that are to be made as one piece.
